facts.fact: Malawi24 reports that the National Registration (Amendment) Regulations 2026, gazetted 31 July 2026, set NRB charges for e-KYC verification (K350 basic, K450 intermediate, K500 advanced) and K500 once-off for mobile money subscribers, SIM card holders, bank account holders and utility services.
The 2026 NRB fee regulations name e-KYC verification charges for mobile money subscribers, SIM card holders, bank account holders and utility services, per Malawi24.
